description: This file contains unit tests for the SugarFieldWysiwyg class, focusing on its getEditViewSmarty method. The tests verify TinyMCE editor initialization, error handling, correct selector generation, logging, and fallback behavior.

classes.name: SugarFieldWysiwygTest
classes.description: Unit test class for SugarFieldWysiwyg, testing TinyMCE initialization, error handling, and selector generation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, creating an instance of SugarFieldWysiwyg.

methods.name: testGetEditViewSmartyHandlesTinyMCEError
methods.description: Tests error handling in getEditViewSmarty when TinyMCE configuration throws an exception.

methods.name: testGetEditViewSmartySuccess
methods.description: Verifies successful TinyMCE config generation and that it's assigned to the template variables.

methods.name: testGetEditViewSmartyWithFormName
methods.description: Tests correct selector generation when a form name is specified in display parameters.

methods.name: testGetEditViewSmartyWithoutFormName
methods.description: Tests correct selector generation when no form name is specified.

methods.name: testGetEditViewSmartyIncludesJavaScriptStructure
methods.description: Checks that the generated TinyMCE config includes expected JavaScript code snippets.

methods.name: testGetEditViewSmartyIncludesHeightOverride
methods.description: Verifies that height override is included in the TinyMCE config.

methods.name: testGetEditViewSmartyLogsInfo
methods.description: Ensures info-level logging occurs during editor loading.

methods.name: testGetEditViewSmartyFallsBackToParentOnError
methods.description: Tests fallback behavior when TinyMCE configuration throws an exception.

methods.name: testGetEditViewSmartyCallsSetup
methods.description: Verifies that the setup method of the editor is called properly.

methods.name: testGetEditViewSmartyUsesCorrectFieldName
methods.description: Checks that the field's name is correctly used in the selector.
